evals.prompt: Set up RFProteína on this machine and confirm it can run. Install the environment, download the example checkpoints into a local DATA_PATH, run the setup preflight, and then run a single-design smoke test on the short monomer benchmark. Use the model checkout identified by RFPROTEINA_ROOT and preserve existing workspace files and Git metadata.
evals.expected_output: An installed RFProteina environment with released checkpoints in DATA_PATH, preflight exit code 0 and PREFLIGHT PASSED, and at least one annotated monomer-short CIF under ./runs/smoke using the configured release checkpoint pair.

requires: Approved model source revision staged in a separate writable checkout per trial; RFPROTEINA_ROOT names its absolute sandbox path

assertions: Runs the selected model checkout's documented installer (make setup or bash setup.sh) and activates or explicitly selects its Python environment
Resolves DATA_PATH from the exported environment or active .env.local/.env file, preserves existing settings, and obtains both released checkpoints if needed
Runs the installed setup skill's preflight.sh against the selected model checkout and it exits 0 (PREFLIGHT PASSED), including native .venv installations without a dispatcher
Runs rfd4-generate inputs=data/benchmarks/monomer subset_to_examples=monomer-short num_replicates=1 out_dir=./runs/smoke
Uses the release checkpoint pair selected by configs/inference.yaml without a checkpoint override
Preserves existing workspace files, Git metadata, data, and environments; does not delete or reset a checkout to make room for a clone
Uses the supplied RFD4-Proteina source and reports actual failures without substituting a different Proteina model, disabling TLS verification, or fabricating dependencies or results
Confirms a successful generation command and a nonempty annotated CIF at the reported output path; preflight alone is not reported as completed generation
